This page is generated at *build* time — the measures table and the
provenance table are queried live from the catalog, and every table's
column docs come straight from the declared schemas
(`canceronice.schemas`) in this repository, not hand-copied. If a release
adds a measure or a schema gains a column, this page's next render shows it.

## Measures

Every measure the catalog currently defines, by source. Type in the search
box to filter.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute("INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;")
con.execute(
    "ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (TYPE ICEBERG, "
    "ENDPOINT 'https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev', "
    "AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none');"
)
measures_df = con.sql("""
    SELECT source, measure_id, label, units, rate_basis, method
    FROM coi.measure.definition
    ORDER BY source, measure_id
""").df()
print(f"{len(measures_df)} measures across {measures_df['source'].nunique()} sources.")
ojs_define(measures_data = measures_df)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
measures = transpose(measures_data)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof measureSearch = Inputs.search(measures, { placeholder: "Search measures (id, label, source)…" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(measureSearch, {
  columns: ["source", "measure_id", "label", "units", "rate_basis", "method"],
  rows: 20
})
```

## Tables

Every table this repository declares (`canceronice.schemas.TABLES`),
grouped by namespace, with its comment, its business key, and every
column's own doc string. A table not yet populated in the live catalog
still appears here — this section is the *declared* schema, not a scan of
what happens to exist right now.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from canceronice import schemas

for ns, ns_doc in schemas.NAMESPACES.items():
    tables_in_ns = sorted(k for k in schemas.TABLES if k.startswith(f"{ns}."))
    if not tables_in_ns:
        continue
    print(f"### `{ns}` — {ns_doc}\n")
    for table_name in tables_in_ns:
        table_def = schemas.TABLES[table_name]
        print(f"#### `{table_name}`\n")
        print(f"{table_def.comment}\n")
        if table_def.business_key:
            print(f"**Business key:** `{', '.join(table_def.business_key)}`  ")
        if table_def.partition_by:
            print(f"**Partitioned by:** `{', '.join(table_def.partition_by)}`  ")
        if table_def.sort_by:
            print(f"**Sorted by:** `{', '.join(table_def.sort_by)}`  ")
        print()
        print("| Column | Type | Required | Doc |")
        print("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
        for f in table_def.schema.fields:
            doc = (f.doc or "").replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")
            print(f"| `{f.name}` | {f.field_type} | {'yes' if f.required else ''} | {doc} |")
        print()
```

## Releases

What each catalog release was built from — source, upstream version, and
when it was retrieved.

```{python}
#| echo: false
con.sql("""
    SELECT release, source, source_version, version_method, retrieved_at, row_count
    FROM coi.provenance.release
    ORDER BY release, source, source_version
""").df()
```
